headline: 3 NPT token deployments catalogued (Ethereum, Polygon, Klaytn); 0 staking, control or fund-holding contracts found on Klaytn/Tron.
short_headline: 3 token addresses; no staking contracts found

findings.text: Only a search-grounded Etherscan page for the NPT token (tag 'Neopin: NPT Token', deployer labelled 'Neopin: Deployer') was seen. No Klaytn (Klaytnscope) or Tron (Tronscan) name-tag search could be fetched, so no staking-pool addresses surfaced.

docs.neopin.io has no dedicated deployed-contracts page in its llms.txt index. The only on-site address list is the NEOPIN Economy page, which gives the NPT token on Ethereum, Polygon and Klaytn. None of the NEOPIN staking / liquid-staking pools or custody contracts are listed.
No audit links are pinned in the context and none were found on the docs site. A third-party aggregator mentions a Certik audit, but it is unverified and no report was opened.
No GitHub repository is pinned, and no NEOPIN-owned repo or deployment artifact was found in the searches run.

Chains are Klaytn and Tron. Klaytn: only the NPT token address, not a staking contract. Tron: zero addresses surfaced. NPT token deployments also exist on Ethereum and Polygon, which are outside the pinned chain list.
No factory addresses were discovered, so no children were enumerated.
Three token entries were recorded, one per chain. Each is classified role 'token' with actor_class 'unknown' because bytecode was not read.

All admin_addresses entries trace to the fetched docs page https://docs.neopin.io/tokenomics/neopin-economy. Addresses seen only in third-party snippets (e.g. coincarp, polygonscan, Etherscan transaction counterparties) were not added.

rationale.verdict: Walked the NEOPIN docs (llms.txt, token economy, stake and liquid-stake pages), the DefiLlama protocol page and API, and a few search results; catalogued 3 NPT token addresses and found no staking, custody or admin contracts on Klaytn or Tron.

evidence.shows: Official docs list NPT token contract addresses: Ethereum 0x306ee01a6bA3b4a8e993fA2C1ADC7ea24462000c, Polygon 0x306ee01a6bA3b4a8e993fA2C1ADC7ea24462000c, Klaytn 0xe06597d02a2c3aa7a9708de2cfa587b128bd3815 (KIP-7). Chains listed: Ethereum, Polygon, Klaytn.

Etherscan page content (returned via search grounding, not a direct fetch) tags the address 'Neopin: NPT Token' and its creator 'Neopin: Deployer'. The deployer address itself is not shown in the returned body.

Full docs index: no deployed-contracts / addresses / audits / security page. Products listed include Stake, Liquid Stake, Pool, Swap, Bridge, Index and Derivatives. Contact page is at /links/contact-us.md (not fetched).
Liquid staking mints npTokens (npETH, npKLAY) of equivalent value to the staked asset. Available services: KLAY and ETH liquid staking. Rewards are auto-compounded.
Stake products offered include ETH, KAIA, TRX and NPT, with rewards plus NPT membership rewards.

DefiLlama pins this protocol with chains Tron and Klaytn and parent NEOPIN. Klaytn TVL is paid in KLAY and Tron TVL in TRX. Tron TVL drops to 0 around Jun 2026, so Tron may no longer be tracked. The adapter module is neopin-staking/index.js. No contract addresses are exposed in this response, other than the NPT token as protocol address on klaytn.
Website fetch returned only an SPA shell (title 'Mayflower Legacy', meta: NEOPIN is a non-custodial Permissioned DeFi protocol). No contract addresses were present.

unknowns: D1: Klaytn/Kaia explorer (klaytnscope / kaiascan) name-tag search for NEOPIN could not be fetched; staking-pool and custody addresses on Klaytn remain unknown.

D1-offchain: no Klaytn or Tron explorer page or defipunkd read-API surfacer was fetched in this run (no staking address was known, and the fetch budget was exhausted). The DefiLlama adapter source on raw.githubusercontent.com was rejected by the fetch allowlist because the URL had not appeared in prior results, so TVL holder addresses for Klaytn and Tron were not obtained.
D1: Tron: Tronscan search for NEOPIN staking contracts not performed; zero addresses surfaced.
D1: 'Neopin: Deployer' label on Etherscan exists but the deployer address was not visible in the returned page body, so it was not recorded.
D2: No official deployed-contracts page found; set deployed_contracts_doc to null. The docs.neopin.io/tokenomics/neopin-economy page lists only NPT token addresses.
D3: No audit report verified. A third-party aggregator (coincarp) mentions a Certik audit, but no report URL was opened, and the DefiLlama API shows audits '0'.
D4: No GitHub repo pinned or discovered for NEOPIN; no deployment artifacts available.
D5: chain Tron: zero addresses surfaced from website, docs, DefiLlama API and search.
D5: chain Klaytn: only the NPT token surfaced; staking / liquid-staking (npKLAY) contracts not found.
D6: no factory contracts discovered; no children enumerated.
D8: addresses seen only in search snippets were excluded from admin_addresses: Etherscan transaction counterparties and polygonscan counterparties.

protocol_metadata: governance_forum, bug_bounty_url, security_contact, voting_token and upgradeability not verified; docs mention a governance vote product (docs.neopin.io/governance-vote) but no forum or token for it was verified. Contact page /links/contact-us.md was not fetched (fetch budget exhausted).

protocol_metadata.about: NEOPIN is a non-custodial 'permissioned DeFi' platform where users stake assets such as ETH, KAIA, TRX and its NPT token to earn staking rewards plus NPT membership rewards. Its liquid staking product mints npTokens (e.g. npETH, npKLAY) of equivalent value to the staked asset, and rewards are auto-compounded.
